svg.text: Overall = 0.85 × search + 0.15 × access; each track = 0.50 quality + 0.35 pass rate + 0.15 speed.
Same group = statistically tied (95% paired-bootstrap CI of the gap includes 0). Reach = famous hard sites passed on ≥ half the attempts.
Mirror = live answers that were right but read from a mirror/aggregator (nitter, redlib…), scored as fails. Cost is a column, not scored.
